scientific_integrity: A complete proof using finite-state group actions, Lucas congruences, an explicit parity invariant and separating suffixes is provided. Finite programs are supporting tests, not proof of the infinite theorem. Independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Binary input, modulus two, patterns with two runs and a final return symbol (three runs in all). Not a Boolean-DFA classification for one accepted residue, not all moduli or arbitrary patterns. The full text of the 2011 trie-automaton work was inaccessible, leaving priority risk.
title: A parity-lift dichotomy for three-run scattered-subsequence Moore counters
